items.q: Who can become a HYPOTEQ partner?
items.a: Real estate agents, fiduciaries, wealth managers, insurance agencies and brokers with a registered company, a valid licence or supervision, KYC/AML compliance and relevant experience.

items.q: How much commission do I earn?
items.a: You earn a **fair commission on every closed deal**, paid out quickly. The exact terms depend on the partner model and are agreed in a first call.

items.q: How does the partner portal work?
items.a: You submit cases and see status, documents and lender feedback in one place. Each partner only sees their own cases, and access is by invitation.

items.q: Do I keep the client relationship?
items.a: Yes. The client relationship stays with you. HYPOTEQ does not sell insurance or investments, so there is no product competition.
Getting started is free: CHF 0 setup. Property valuation with Wüest Partner is included for your cases.
